chapter.heading: Proclamation Against Moab
chapter.v:
The burden
against Moab.Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid wasteAnd destroyed,Because in the night Kir of Moab is laid wasteAnd destroyed, [Ps. 46:4; Is. 30:25; 55:1; [Jer. 2:13]; Joel 3:18; Zech. 13:1; 14:8; [Rev. 22:1, 17]]

He has
gone up to the temple and Dibon,To the high places to weep.Moab will wail over Nebo and over Medeba;On all their heads will be baldness,And every beard cut off. [Ezek. 44:1,]

In their
streets they will clothe themselves with sackcloth;On the tops of their housesAnd in their streetsEveryone will wail, weeping bitterly. [Ezek. 40:3]

Heshbon and
Elealeh will cry out,Their voice shall be heard as far as Jahaz;Therefore the armed soldiers of Moab will cry out;His life will be burdensome to him.

“Myheart will
cry out for Moab;His fugitives shall flee to Zoar,Like a three-year-old heifer.For by the Ascent of LuhithThey will go up with weeping;For in the way of HoronaimThey will raise up a cry of destruction,

For the
waters of Nimrim will be desolate,For the green grass has withered away;The grass fails, there is nothing green.

Therefore the
abundance they have gained,And what they have laid up,They will carry away to the Brook of the Willows. [[Is. 60:13, 21; 61:3; Ezek. 47:12; Rev. 22:2]]

For the
cry has gone all around the borders of Moab,Its wailing to EglaimAnd its wailing to Beer Elim.

For the
waters of Dimon will be full of blood;Because I will bring more upon Dimon,Lions upon him who escapes from Moab,And on the remnant of the land.”
